characters.role: the reader / main character, a brave young treasure hunter
your fellow treasure hunter and best mate
the chatty, friendly parrot who gives clues

coverMeta.personalizedTitle: Captain Alex and the Friendly Treasure Hunt

pages.text:
The sun sparkles on the cozy cove as the kind old Captain unrolls a crinkly treasure map. "Ahoy, mateys," says the Captain with a wink. "A grand treasure waits for brave hearts like yours."

On the Captain's shoulder, the chatty parrot Pip flaps and squawks, "Two paths, two paths!" You and Sam study the map with wide eyes.

choices.text: Take the swaying palm tree path

pages.text:
The warm sand tickles your toes as you follow the beach past little tide pools full of tickly crabs. Pip zips overhead, calling out cheery directions.

One curious crab scuttles along a shell path, while a soft patch of sand nearby has a big X drawn right on top.

choices.text: Dig where the X is drawn

pages.text:
Tall palm trees sway and drop bouncy coconuts as you walk the leafy path. Sam juggles a coconut and laughs when it rolls away.

Pip lands on a branch and points a wing two ways: up the tallest tree for a grand view, or along the path where the parrot flutters ahead.

choices.text: Climb the tall palm for a view

pages.text:
The path leads you to a huge friendly rock shaped like a sleeping whale, with a bright red X painted on its side. "This must be the spot," you cheer.

You notice a cool shady cave just behind the rock, and a curious gap beneath the rock where something glints in the sun.

You come upon a little wooden rowboat resting on the sand, painted with cheerful stripes. Pip perches on the tiny mast and preens a feather.

The boat could carry you to a sunny sandbar just offshore, or you could search the cozy boat itself for hidden clues.

choices.text: Row out to the sunny sandbar

pages.text:
There it is: a small wooden treasure chest with a shiny golden latch, nestled in the sand. Sam gasps with delight, and Pip does a happy loop in the air.

A tiny golden key hangs from a ribbon nearby, and the lid also looks loose enough to lift with gentle hands.

choices.text: Open it with the golden key

pages.text:
Instead of a chest, you find a green glass bottle with a rolled up note inside. You uncork it and read a riddle written in swirly pirate letters.

"The finest treasure," it says, "is closer than you think." Pip bobs its head as if it knew all along.

choices.text: Follow the riddle to the lagoon
Bring the note back to the Captain

pages.text:
With a gentle turn and a soft creak, everything opens up to reveal the treasure. Inside are cozy blankets, a basket of fruit, and a stack of drawings of the whole crew smiling together.

"This is not gold," you say slowly, "but it feels even better." The Captain chuckles warmly from behind you.

choices.text: Read the note tucked on top

pages.text:
The Captain gathers the whole crew on the sunny shore, and everyone shares a warm laugh. "The true treasure," the Captain says, "was never gold or jewels at all."

Pip squawks happily, "Friends, friends!" and lands right on your shoulder. You and Sam beam with joy.

choices.text: Share a great big group hug

pages.text:
You spread the cozy blankets on the golden sand and share the basket of sweet fruit with the whole crew. The Captain tells funny tales of gentle waves and silly seagulls.

As the sun dips low, you all watch the sky turn pink and orange. The best treasure is a day shared with friends. The end.

The note reads, "True treasure is the crew who sails beside you." You look around at Sam, the kind Captain, and cheerful Pip, and your heart feels full.

You pin the drawings up in the ship's cabin so you can see your treasure every day. The end.

The old Captain plops a fine feathered hat on your head and names you Captain for a Day. Pip salutes with a wing and calls you the bravest sailor on the cove.

You steer the little boat in happy circles while everyone cheers. What a sunny, silly, wonderful adventure. The end.
